## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages start with the task ID.
- [ ] `python scripts/dashboard.py` reports `OVERALL: GREEN` (lint, format, strict types, tests with
      the coverage gate, the validator, and the docs build).
- [ ] New and changed functions have tests, and the tests can fail.
- [ ] Public functions have numpy-style docstrings with complete type annotations.
- [ ] The roadmap, backlog, changelog, and issue bodies are in step with the change.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, or machine-specific paths are included.
